I am a **geographer** and a **master's student in Geography** at the University of Brasília (UnB), Brazil. My work sits at the intersection of **geography, climate and public health**. I use spatial analysis, GIS and data visualization to understand how places and extreme climate events affect people's health.

I am a research collaborator at the **Laboratory of Geography, Environment and Health (LAGAS/UnB)**. There I work on [GeoCalor](projects/geocalor/index.qmd), a project on the health impacts of heat waves. I also develop [localdatasus](projects/localdatasus/index.qmd), an R package that downloads Brazilian public health data (SUS) at the **neighborhood** level.

On this site you will find my [projects](projects.qmd), [code](code.qmd), [tutorials](tutorials.qmd) and my [CV](cv.qmd).

### Interests

- Health geography and spatial epidemiology
- Climate, heat waves and extreme events
- Remote sensing and burned-area mapping
- Dashboards and geographic data visualization
- QGIS, ArcGIS Pro, Python (ArcPy), R and spatial databases
